name: Nonohara Makoto
source:
The son of Mikako, he's living as a servant at the mansion, the same as you, and is often called to perform sexual acts with Mamiya family and their friends. He's a very eager worker, always eager to please and be pleased. [spoiler]In truth, he and his mother are slaves to the Mamiyas due to their family's restaurant debt. Once the deadline pasts, the two will be sold through Marie's auction event in which he will be bid by Yukari and turned into her sex slave.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/starless.html]JAST USA[/url]]
